title: AMD action: lookup-patient
description: Search patients by name fragment or chart number; the primary way to resolve a name to a patient_id. Returns top-level query, page, count, matches, and narrow_query (true when AMD held back results because the search is too broad). Each row in matches carries patient_id, chart_number, first_name, last_name, and dob. Matches are capped at 5 to discourage enumeration. Pass only a query fragment, no PHI body.

page.description: Optional 1-based page index for paged enumeration (AARON-REVIEWABLE-2 / DUO-11 default: extend in-place rather than ship a second tool).

query.description: Name fragment or chart number to search.
